parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance whose configuration you want to change.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
The type of configuration change. Valid values:

- Upgrade

- Downgrade

parameters.name: Parameter
parameters.description: The list of parameters. You can specify up to 100 parameters.

sub_parameters.name: Code
sub_parameters.description:
The code of the module property.

> Specify only the module properties that you want to change. For example, if you have two properties, A and B, and you only want to change property A, pass only the information related to property A.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the module property.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

- Subscription: subscription.

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.
